_comment: Seam-A deterministic narration templates for NPC ruler actions (gdd-ruler-ai.md 9.1; fragment-bank convention per gdd-npc-personality.md 9.3). Keyed by planner action_id; {ruler} and {realm} are substituted by RulerActionNarrator. '_default' covers unknown ids.

action_phrases.administer_domain: {ruler} spends the month in the halls of {realm}, hearing petitions and setting affairs in order.
action_phrases.oversee_investment: {ruler} directs coin and laborers toward the fields and workshops of {realm}.
action_phrases.raise_garrison: {ruler} calls up soldiers to strengthen the garrison of {realm}.
action_phrases.repress_population: {ruler} sends soldiers into the streets and villages of {realm} to cow the restless.
action_phrases.train_troops: {ruler} drills the soldiery of {realm} on the practice fields.
action_phrases.manage_stronghold: {ruler} sets masons and engineers to work upon the stronghold of {realm}.
action_phrases.defensive_resistance: {ruler} marshals the defenders of {realm} against the invader.
action_phrases.call_to_arms: {ruler} sends riders to summon the vassals of {realm} to war.
action_phrases.withstand_siege: {ruler} looks to the walls as {realm} endures the siege.
